title: Upper Quad Footbridge, 07:18: Water at the Top of the Wall

fields.sceneBrief: Phone photo taken from a small pedestrian footbridge looking upstream along an open stone-and-concrete creek channel through a university quad at first light, blue-grey dawn with steady rain. Fast brown floodwater runs level with the top of the channel wall and carries a whole leafless tree limb with branches sticking up out of the current. The paved footpath beside the channel is awash under a thin sheet of moving water, with a lamppost still lit and reflecting on the wet surface. Bare spring trees and the dark outline of brick campus buildings behind, a few windows lit. Raindrops on the lens, slight blur from the moving water, no people on the path.
fields.caption: Upper Quad, 07:18, water at the top of the wall. Lot C low corner starting to pond.
fields.location: Upper Quad footbridge, Sugar Camp Run

instructorNote: Show this photo while the SimCell reads the 07:20 dashboard alarm (STAGE 7.03 ft, flood stage exceeded; 07:10 6.75 | 07:02 6.51 | 06:50 6.15; rising +1.7 ft/hr) and Tech 4's radio call about 2 inches in Lot C and the 40-minute fleet move. Watch for the IC to declare Level 1 with a logged time and basis and invite the Marlowe Police and Fire liaisons, the Sugar Run Apartments advisory to Kessler Fieldhouse (45-minute clearance) with the PIO alert within 15 minutes, DoS opening Kessler, and Fac starting the Lot C move now so it finishes before 8.5 ft.
